scientific_integrity: Archival cross-join connectivity and order-five degree frequencies are credited; the new assessment is confined to maximum complete subgraphs and their exact number. A 2013 ePrint record predates the earliest independently day-dated accessible source, dated 2014-12-05; its first public posting day was not confirmed and the recorded receipt date is not treated as a public release date.
scientific_limitations: The general clique upper bound holds for all binary orders at least four, but exact sharpness and extremal-clique counts have been established only at orders four and five. The order-five exhaustivity is finite, checked by two enumeration methods; independent validation and definitive historical priority are not claimed.
title: Sharp cross-join clique bound and complete extremal order-five classification
